name: The Battle of Poltava and the Final Defeat of the Hetmanate (1709) (C0015)

techniques.comment: The liquidation of the autonomy's statehood and international agency as a result of the defeat of the Swedish-Ukrainian forces. The rout at Poltava set off an irreversible process of dismantlement: "In the hundred years after the famous Pereiaslav Council, Ukraine traveled the path from the 'Articles of Bohdan Khmelnytsky'… to the de facto liquidation of the autonomy and the hetmanate, to the country's transformation into an ordinary province of the Russian Empire"(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011).

Physical destruction of the armed forces of the supporters of independence in a general battle in order to eliminate the military potential of the resistance(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011).

Mass executions of captured Cossacks after the capitulation at Perevolochna and Poltava for the final intimidation of the supporters of autonomy(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011).
